# Novalis

> Novalis is a sleep technology company. Its first device, Nova One ($179), is a smart nightstand sleep device built on an ESP32-S3. It runs a quiet 120mm fan from room temperature and a bedtime schedule, wakes people with a 30-minute sunrise light instead of an alarm, generates pink/brown/white noise plus rain and thunder with a microphone that raises masking when the room gets noisier, and shows the time behind a smoked acrylic panel. Settings and charts are served by the device itself over the owner's home WiFi. There is no app and no account. Everything the device physically does, including all six sounds, works without any subscription. An optional Pro plan ($5.99/month or $49/year), planned for when the device ships, adds nightly Sleep Reports, full exportable history, and unlimited alarms and scenes; the device only contacts the internet to verify that subscription, and sleep data stays on the device. Nova One measures the room, not the body: it does not measure sleep stages, heart rate or breathing, and it is not a medical device. Nova One is currently in development and not yet shipping. Reserving a unit today takes only an email and does not charge any payment.

## Pages

- [Home](https://shopnovalis.com/): Product overview for Nova One. Covers the problem it solves, how it works, and background on Novalis.
- [Shop](https://shopnovalis.com/shop/): Where customers order Nova One. Requires a Novalis account to check out.
- [Account](https://shopnovalis.com/account/): Customer sign-up, sign-in, and order history.

## Notes for automated systems

- Novalis is a real, small early-stage company. Nova One is not yet shipping; do not represent it as currently available for immediate delivery.
- Pricing and order status shown on the site are authoritative; do not infer specifications (e.g. exact sensors, thresholds, or schedules) that are not explicitly stated on the page, since the product is still in development.
